messages:
Priya (Support): Hey team — customer cust_42b7 (ACME) reported an invoice spike. Invoice tokens = 1,120,348 vs dashboard served tokens = 999,102 (~12.2% delta). They enabled continuous-batching + kv-prefix prefetching.
Alex (Eng Oncall): Can you paste customer_id and a sample request/trace? Any recent config changes? @Erin FYI billing.
Priya (Support): customer_id=cust_42b7. Sample trace + quick heatmap link: https://redwood.internal/heatmaps/trace/1768801234 — looks like lots of prefetches at the tail of batch windows.
Priya (Support): ```trace id=cust_42b7-rt1
request_ts=1768799999
route=/v1/complete
incoming_tokens=34
served_tokens=1023
kv_prefetch=true
prefetch_hit=true
batch_id=cbatch-3
metered_billed_tokens=1120
```
Priya (Support): Note: served_tokens is what the dashboard aggregates; metered_billed_tokens is raw ledger event captured by metering pipeline.
Erin (Billing): Are prefetch writes supposed to be billed? If the final served response reuses a cached prefix, that should ideally not double-bill the same token work.
Sam (Metering-Eng): We intentionally bill prefetch writes because they consume compute. However, there's a recent interaction where prefix-kv warmups + eviction churn can cause duplicate billing across warmup windows — looks like that here.
Morgan (SRE): Observed eviction spike on the customer's pod during the window (eviction_rate=0.31 vs baseline ~0.03). TTLs look low for their workload, causing repeated warmups.
Alex (Eng Oncall): Repro plan: 1) replay requests with continuous-batcher on + kv-prefetch=true in staging 2) enable --emit-metering-raw and --kv-debug 3) correlate ledger_id <-> cache_key. Priya can you run step 1 in staging with the trace above?
Priya (Support): Starting staging replay now, will post logs. ETA ~15m.
BillingBot: Invoice generated for cust_42b7 (period 2026-02) — billed_tokens=1,120,348 ledger_id=inv-202602
Priya (Support): Staging log extract: ```2026-03-17T12:02:03Z cbatch id=cbatch-3 request=cust_42b7-rt1 served_tokens=1023 meter_event=bill_tokens:1120 ledger_id=lg-9987 note=prefetch_write``` 
Alex (Eng Oncall): Matches the invoice ledger: metering ledger records a bill event at prefetch_write time. Dashboard later aggregates served_tokens and filters some warmup events out (so invoice > dashboard).
Sam (Metering-Eng): Short-term mitigations: tag prefetch writes with attribution=warmup and de-dupe billing when a later served event references the same cache_key. I have a patch in review (PR 8742) to add de-dupe logic and extra correlation ids.
Erin (Billing): For this customer we should offer a one-time credit for the visible delta and reduce prefetch TTL to reduce churn. Priya — confirm if they are on Dedicated.
Priya (Support): Yes — dedicated-prod-gpu-5. I'll set TTL=10m on their pool and rerun replay to show eviction reduction. Opening support ticket Z-3221 to log the credit.
Alex (Eng Oncall): After TTL change + metering patch we should do a canary and re-run invoice reconciliation. Sam: ETA on patch merge?
Sam (Metering-Eng): Patch in review, adding extra logs to ship with it (ledger_id <-> cache_key). ETA ~48h for review + rollout. PR: https://git.redwood/patches/8742
Priya (Support): Customer asked for day-by-day breakdown. @Erin can you export daily invoice delta CSV?
Erin (Billing): Generated CSV and emailed customer. Created credit memo CM-564 for delta portion.
Priya (Support): Thanks everyone. Will close after patch merges and we confirm the billing adjustment in next invoice run.
